name: browse_files
description: Show the files in a folder (and all its subfolders) as a table: name, date arrived on this PC, size, folder. Filters: in = videos|downloads|documents|desktop|pictures|music|home, a full path or a folder name; kind; ext like 'pdf,mkv'; name = words in the file name; when = 'today'|'last week'|'october'|'2025'|'last 30 days'|'older than 6 months'; size = 'over 1gb'|'under 10mb'. sort = arrived|modified|size|name|type|folder, order = desc|asc, limit = top N (ALWAYS set it when the user says only/just/top N). show = extra columns the user asked for, from size,folder,type (the table has name + date by default).
